note.title: Your account lives on this device
note.text: You can start without registering. Your tanks and entries stay private and are saved on this device until you register.
note.loss: If you uninstall the app or wipe the device, they are lost. A registration keeps everything.

tankToday.title: How does your tank look today?
tankToday.text: Set up your tank and take its first photo.
